name: agents-md-test-laws-drift
body: AGENTS.md ('Test tiers & the tier-separable harness') cites three global laws that were not authored nodes: `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries`, `global.constraint.no-real-project-test`, and `global.constraint.self-contained-tests`. The `global` layer held only `build-toolchain-pins`, `checkout-independent-graph-identity`, `frontend-dependency-contract`, and `scan-time-tool-failure-actionable`. [autonomous] I authored all three from the AGENTS.md prose, re-stating `test-tier-boundaries` to the NEW layout (e2e in top-level `tests/`, unit/int in a sibling `tests.rs`, each `#[ignore]`d e2e test carrying the `cargo test-e2e` marker) rather than the retired inline-`mod tests` layout, and authored `behaviour-preserving-refactor` and `module-size-budget` as the new laws this change-set adds. AGENTS.md remains the prose guide; it is not in the branch graph, so updating it to the new layout is prose work the plan must schedule separately.
